verdict.rationale: Zapier documents two official CLIs. The Platform CLI builds integrations (Node.js, OAuth, webhooks, triggers). The Zapier SDK CLI explores and runs actions across thousands of apps from the terminal with no OAuth setup. The SDK tooling is explicitly positioned for coding agents, which can run it as a CLI, agent skill or local MCP server. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of either CLI, and detailed first-party documentation of the SDK CLI's agent-oriented commands and output formats.
